title: Scopes of Alignment
reasoning: The paper's central thesis is the proposal of a multi-dimensional framework for AI alignment based on moral and ethical values. It extensively discusses moral psychology, moral foundations theory, and dyadic morality. Furthermore, it incorporates specific religious-philosophical terminology from Hinduism (sadhāraṇa-dharma and viśeṣa-dharma) to categorize behaviors, making religious and ethical frameworks fundamental to its proposed taxonomy.
